label: locating a day: today, yesterday, tomorrow — and the week, month and year
note: adya, hyaḥ, śvaḥ, paraśvaḥ, māsaḥ, saṁvatsaraḥ -- an unusually full set, and as of chapter 56 two of the three relative days can finally be USED: adya with the present and hyaḥ with the past. śvaḥ still waits on a future tense the track does not teach. THE WEEKDAY NAMES, THE MONTH NAMES AND THE SIX SEASON NAMES ARE ALL STILL ABSENT, so a learner has the relative days and no calendar; chapter 61 adds the generic ṛtuḥ and not the six names.
